‘X’ is a 6-digit number formed using exactly three different digits. One of the digits appears once, another appears twice, and the third appears three times. When 2 lakhs are added to ‘X’, the resulting number ‘Y’ is still a 6-digit number. What is the highest possible value of ‘Y’?
a) 977889
b) 999999
c) 999988
d) 999887
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with the first digit of X. If X starts with 8 or 9, what happens when you add 2,00,000?
Slicer
break it into small parts
Then fill the other five places: which digit should appear three times, and which twice, to make X as big as possible?
YOUR TURN
Write the biggest X, then add 2,00,000.
